description:
A Windows utility for tweaking, optimizing, and customizing your system.

Winchisel is a Windows utility for tweaking, optimizing, and customizing your system. It includes a debloater, performance and privacy tweaks, app downloads, process tools, a startup manager, scheduled-task management, and extras — with risk badges, recommended defaults, and automatic updates.
What's new in v1.1.2
🐛 Fixes
- Fix Extras string writes and PowerShell 7 telemetry broadcast (c9ad2b7)
🔧 Improvements
- Persist debloat and downloads scans across launches (7ca1f19)
- Refresh debloat and winget scans in the background after 24 h (06e2e55)
Maintenance (3)
- Add force option to the nightly workflow (8e2200f)
- Skip nightly build when newest green commit changes workflows (6ccb701)
- Make forced nightly build master regardless of CI (0fb3592)
Install: winget install lejy.Winchisel · or download Winchisel-Setup-x64.exe (installer) / Winchisel-Portable-x64.exe (no install) below.
Full changelog: v1.1.1...v1.1.2
